description: Deterministic inputs for the Reliability, Observability & Cost reference simulation. Providers are mocked in memory.
scenarios: SRE sees a deploy SLO burn, preserved trace context, and rollback obligation.
FinOps lead sees metered spend, credit headroom, quota degradation, and runaway-spend halt.
Incident commander sees partial deploy failure classified and compensated with replay evidence.
SRE sees Golden Suite plus chaos evidence folded into degraded reliability status.
